headline: DEFENDER hauls fight back — and the patrol earned its 20/20 back
lede: Stage 3 of the survival arc (#3456) merged as e1c1f3b: guns live during the cargo elevator, a 1981 speeder endgame when the last lander falls, and the momentum law that reads where the hull is headed, not where it is. The patrol now survives 20/20 on both audit sets — mortal, honest, and re-pinned so copy can never outrun measurement again.

notes.text: Resumed a dead lane rather than rebuilding it: slot a's stage-3 PR was open with every gate green but unmerged. Rebased onto main (#3473's top-of-haul mutation landed mid-flight), re-ran defendercheck 146/0 and 38/38 mutants on the merged sim, merged and prod-verified.

The two changes compose: #3473 documents the save window as the ascent — shoot the hauler, catch the falling human — and stage 3's haul guns are exactly what lets the pilot take it. Post-merge diedHauling 3 + 7, down from 12 + 11 at stage 2.
Survival copy claim `survives 20/20` is back in the README and registry — pinned to the witness by a drift law (no claim without both sets), with worstSeedHits >= 3 as its own frozen-grace tripwire.

Harness lesson: forge-merge.sh under a tool timeout looks hung while CI is merely slow, but its merge completes server-side — verify PR state before retrying, and run the merge backgrounded with an output file.
